name: k8s_warning_event_ratio_anomaly
title: Share of Warning events is unusually high
description: Share of Kubernetes events of type Warning in the k8s_events stream is above its learned band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets. Counts all watch records (ADDED, MODIFIED and DELETED). Unit: ratio 0-1. Ratios are floored at 1% (0.01) and buckets with fewer than 20 events report the floor. Edit the two constants in custom_sql to tune. Whole stream; add AND k8s_cluster = '...' or a k8s_namespace_name condition to the WHERE clause after install for a per-entity alert (one config per entity). Needs steady event activity: a five-minute bucket with no Event watch record returns no row (the floor applies only to non-empty buckets), and training needs at least 100 non-empty five-minute buckets; on a quiet cluster training fails and keeps retrying.

anomaly_config.custom_sql: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5m') AS time_bucket, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 20 THEN 0.01 ELSE GREATEST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN body_object_type = 'Warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), 0.01) END AS warning_ratio FROM "k8s_events" WHERE k8s_resource_name = 'events' GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket
